claims.statement: A second signal determined by the first makes the gate a one-input function; with matching presence and fixed high severity it reaches only tolerance or quarantine.
claims.limits: Elementary substitution/table result; it does not prove independence or accuracy of actual detectors.

claims.statement: For positive K and exponent, a Hill gate is a threshold on the positive-input sum; the half-activation threshold is K. A contributor count requires a per-entry upper bound.
claims.limits: Distinct agents, independence and provenance do not follow from counting positive entries.

claims.statement: Screening has no executed hit on every admitted finite panel exactly when the executed predicate implies the screened predicate; avoiding harmless rejection adds the reverse implication.
claims.limits: Panel-relative property; equality of predicates establishes neither coverage of valid unseen inputs nor a false-suppression rate.

claims.statement: The standalone typed host restores semantic state on a refused batch while retaining its fuel charge and event-chain receipt; all declared witness routes currently refuse with NO_NATIVE_PORT.
claims.limits: Charged batches only; no total bytes/time/money bound, witness certificate, authenticated producer or native/Python refinement proof.

findings.statement: The four dated validation JSONs and ownership guard have later role/path substitutions, including command cwd, input-hash key names, captured compiler stdout, suite names and owner paths. Original archived records remain intact. Label current copies as edited transcriptions with explicit mapping; preserving dates is not preservation of original bytes. This is not evidence of fabricated historical test outcomes.

Current prose and TeX replace historical module names inside commit-pinned source URLs and command paths without changing commit IDs; Markdown uses pfp where TeX uses symbol_game. The archive retains original omega_engine paths. Reproduction needs a versioned old-to-current map, not a silent substitution within a historical citation. Historical PDF bytes also predate the October23 Markdown extension.

The three-cycle prompt advertises a differential adjustment whose sum is zero as closing initial holonomy five; under additive semantics the holonomy remains five. The diamond prompt initial cycle-sum norm is ten while feedback reports eight. All fifteen raw trace rows retain pending/false admission and -1 numerical fields. Preserve these as historical proposals/feedback, not checked execution results; a different quotient metric would need its own explicit binding.

Thirty historical trial records reduce to ten distinct bodies after seed and envelope hash removal; snippets, usage and state digests repeat exactly across three seeds. All forty-eight finite witness dispositions and aggregate arithmetic reproduce, but this cannot establish thirty independent model calls or a causal improvement. The receipt lacks request IDs, full prompts/replies, money and latency. Repetition alone is not proof of fabrication.

The three historical notebooks import runners absent from the deposit and retain only empty output cells. Their finite illustrations remain useful, but standalone executable demonstration claims require bundled, pinned dependencies and fresh receipts.
Live request has no max_tokens or whole-run monetary reservation and returns only text, discarding supplied usage. Route through the guarded benchmark transport before any paid comparison.

Missing credentials or a failed live query still lead to overall PASSED and zero CLI exit after four offline examples. Nested acquisition status is explicit, but the top-level result cannot be treated as successful live execution.

Python JSON parsing accepts a NaN witness payload without a structural defect; later allow_nan=False event serialization raises outside the wrapper instead of returning a structured refusal. A public synthetic response reproduces this.

The native hex helper slices arbitrary UTF-8 text at two-byte offsets. Even-byte-length a-é-a panics inside a codepoint instead of returning an invalid-hex refusal. Exact isolated source compilation reproduces it; full native package was not built.

Current MANIFEST.sha256 and SHA256SUMS have 44/45 raw mismatches, of which 26/27 survive universal LF normalization. All archived bindings pass. Archive logical contents now have separate full reading and exact reconstruction evidence; hash agreement alone would not complete that review.

Author-review extension links still target ../029_pfp_evidence_bound_harness_evolution rather than the current 019 directory. Historical Demo1/Demo2 relative dependencies and atlas source_paths also require explicit current-location guidance.

Study-guide page 2 (companion page 3) overlaps severity, exact decision and refusal columns, obscuring the gate table. Instructor-key page 3 (companion page 9) overlaps full commit hashes with their descriptions. Markdown retains the complete data; preserve historical PDFs and repair a newly bound edition.

limits: Complete eighty-file supporting slice and contextual current-manuscript review, including three notebooks, four traces, full TeX, thirty-trial receipt, 62 PDF pages and 79 archive logical contents. Runtime results remain scoped to fifty-nine Python passes, one native skip, seven isolated controls and independent historical rational/arithmetic checks. No notebook, full native package, provider, private answer or original-source mutation. This does not complete the broader repository audit or establish model improvement.
